evidence: Representative thickness saturation curves for films deposited at 120 8C by 400 ALD cycles at various precursor dosages are shown in Figure 2 a, b. As shown in Figure 2 a, the film thickness first increased with the Fe(amd)2 exposure, and then reached saturation as the Fe(amd) 2 exposure exceeded about 0.025 T orr s while the amount of H 2S was kept fixed at approximately 0.062 Torr s.
